$comment: One-line meanings for every key of the bento/slides format, read by scripts/build-agent-docs.mjs. Every key in slides/src/modelkeys.generated.ts (and every sub-object the schema describes inline) needs a line here, or the build fails; a line for a key the format no longer has fails it too. Element keys: a type's own entry wins over the shared `element` entry. Types, enums, ranges and required flags come from the schema, so write only what the key MEANS.

doc.format: Format discriminant, always "bento/slides". Check it before editing a file.
doc.version: Format version. The current shells write 1.
doc.docId: The document's identity (uuid), minted on first open. Omit it in a new deck; never change it in an existing one.
doc.title: Deck title; also the HTML title and {{title}}.
doc.size: The slide coordinate space in px. Default 1280×720.
doc.theme: Deck-wide defaults: colours, fonts, palette slots, tokens.
doc.present: How the show draws its own chrome and paces morphs and typewriters.
doc.slides: The slides in show order; a state slide sits right after its parent. Must be non-empty.
doc.layouts: The deck's own slide templates (Slide-shaped), offered beside the built-ins under Apply layout.
doc.assets: Shared data: key → data: URI or raw SVG markup, referenced as `asset:<key>`. Written last in a saved file.
doc.blobs: Written by live collaboration for large assets. Never author it.
doc.fonts: Faces the deck carries, each an @font-face at boot.
doc.modified: Last-saved timestamp, written by the app.
doc.readonly: true makes a player file: it boots into the show with no editor.
doc.template: true makes a template: every open mints a fresh document.
doc.collab: Live-session credentials. Any key in it is access to the room: read the deck without it and write it back unchanged.

theme.accent: The accent colour (palette slot accent1); seeds derived chart colours.
theme.fontFamily: Font stack for body text; a full-document text box without fontFamily draws in it.
theme.codeFontFamily: Font stack for code elements without their own fontFamily. Absent = fontFamily.
theme.headingFamily: Display face for headings. Absent = fontFamily.
theme.palette: Further named brand slots that themeRefs can point at.
theme.chartPalette: Ordered series colours for new charts. Absent = derived from accent.
theme.table: Defaults for newly inserted tables; existing tables keep their own style.
theme.tokens: Design tokens: named values element properties bind to with themeRefs "$name".

themeTokens.modes: Mode names in order (e.g. light, dark). Absent = the single mode "default".
themeTokens.mode: The active mode. Absent = the first. Switching it rewrites every bound literal.
themeTokens.set: Token name → { type, values: { mode → value } }. Names match `[A-Za-z][\w.-]*`, up to 64 characters.

present.slideNumber: The show's "3 / 12" counter. Default true; switch it off when the slides number themselves.
present.progress: The show's progress bar along the bottom. Default true.
present.controls: Arrow buttons in the corner while presenting. Default false.
present.numberHidden: true: hidden slides keep their page number. Default false (skipped slides are uncounted).
present.morphSeconds: Morph duration in seconds. Absent = 0.65; clamped to 0.1–6 on read.
present.typeWriterSeconds: Typewriter pace, seconds per character. Absent = 0.08; a whole run never takes longer than 6 s.

meta.author: Fills {{author}}.
meta.subject: Fills {{subject}}.
meta.keywords: Keywords; provenance only, no field token.

font.family: The family name text uses in its font stack.
font.asset: `asset:<key>` (a woff2 data URI in assets), or a face the app carries by builtin: key, with no bytes in the file.

slide.id: Stable slide id; links, stateOf and morphs reference it.
slide.background: Slide background colour. A full document's slide without it is white, not theme.background.
slide.transition: How the slide arrives; morph tweens elements that share a morph key with the previous slide.
slide.elements: The slide's elements. Array order is paint order: the first is at the back.
slide.notes: Speaker notes; they travel in the file.
slide.themeRefs: Palette slot or $token for the slide's own colours (background).
slide.name: Friendly name for link pickers and state badges.
slide.stateOf: This slide is a hidden variant of the named slide, reached only by links; ← returns to the parent.
slide.hidden: Out of the show (arrow keys skip it, PDF leaves it out) but reachable by a link: backup and appendix slides.
slide.unnumbered: In the walk but takes no page number: {{page}} shows the previous slide's, so a build over several morph slides reads as one page.
slide.hover: Present-mode hover: focus-group dims elements outside the hovered group; reveal swaps showOnHover sets.
slide.comments: Review threads. Saved in the file, never drawn in the show or print.

slideHover.dim: focus-group: opacity of the elements outside the hovered group. Absent = 0.13.
slideHover.default: reveal: the showOnHover set visible while nothing is hovered.

comment.elementId: The element the thread is pinned to. Absent (or dangling) = the slide.
comment.x: Point anchor in slide px, when no elementId.
comment.y: Point anchor in slide px, when no elementId.
comment.author: Who wrote it.

element.id: Identity on the slide, and the default morph key: elements sharing it across adjacent slides morph.
element.name: The author's name for it in the layer list. Display only.
element.morphId: Morph key override: pairs with an element whose morphId or id matches, without touching id. Unique within a slide.
element.shadow: Drop shadow(s) following the element's alpha shape; an array stacks.
element.blur: Gaussian blur on the element, px.
element.blend: CSS mix-blend-mode (screen, multiply, overlay …). Absent = normal.
element.backdropFilter: Frosted-glass blur of what lies behind, px. Screen only: print drops it.
element.fx: Presentation effects: entrance, click step, count-up, ambient motion, loops. Run while presenting only.
element.link: Click target while presenting: a slide id, or an http(s) URL (opens in a new tab).
element.group: Semantic group tag that hover focus and reveal target.
element.groupId: Editor grouping: elements sharing it select and move as one.
element.groupName: The group's name in the layer list, carried by every member.
element.locked: Editor lock: canvas clicks and marquees skip it. Ignored by present and print.
element.showOnHover: Visible only while an element whose group equals this value is hovered (slide hover type reveal).
element.role: What it is on the slide; a layout (and compact input) places content by role.
element.themeRefs: Property path → palette slot ("accent1", "accent1 -20%") or design token ("$name"). The literal stays on the element and must equal what the ref resolves to.
element.parentId: The auto-layout frame (a rect with layout) this element sits in; the frame derives its x/y/w/h.
element.sizing: Inside a frame: fill takes the frame's free space on that axis; absent = fixed.
element.component: Component membership: elements sharing component.id form a component; main marks the main, every other set is a copy.
element.keepAspectRatio: Resizing keeps the proportions. Images read absent as true, everything else as false.
element.alt: What a screen reader says for a non-text element. Absent = decorative.
element.hidden: Not drawn anywhere (canvas, show, print, preview); still listed in Layers.
element.fillHidden: The fill is switched off but kept.
element.strokeHidden: The stroke is switched off but kept.
element.shadowHidden: The shadow is switched off but kept.
element.blurHidden: The blur is switched off but kept.
element.flipX: Drawn mirrored across the vertical centre line; the box is unchanged.
element.flipY: Drawn mirrored across the horizontal centre line; the box is unchanged.

text.html: The text as sanitized HTML. Inline b strong i em u s code br span a, blocks p div h1 h2 ul ol li; attributes stripped except an http(s) href. $…$ and $$…$$ are maths; {{page}} and friends resolve at render.
text.fontFamily: CSS font stack. Omit it in a full document and the box follows theme.fontFamily.
text.colorGradient: A gradient painted into the glyphs; wins over color.
text.lineHeight: Line height as a multiple of the font size.
text.textStroke: Outline glyphs; fill "none" makes them hollow.
text.placeholder: Dimmed prompt shown in the editor while html is empty; the element is hidden in the show and print while empty.

textStroke.fill: Glyph interior; "none" for hollow letters. Absent = the text colour.

code.grammarName: The language that colours it. Absent = js.
code.fontFamily: CSS font stack. Absent = theme.codeFontFamily, then theme.fontFamily.
code.color: Base text colour before token colours apply.
code.lineHeight: Line height as a multiple of the font size.
code.grammarAssetId: Reserved: a grammar carried as a deck asset. Not used by the current shell.
code.themeAssetId: Reserved: a colour theme carried as a deck asset. Not used by the current shell.
code.themeName: Reserved: a named colour theme. Token colours come from theme.codePalette.

shape.fill: Fill colour; on a line, the line's colour. Mirrors the top layer when fills is set.
shape.fillGradient: Gradient fill; wins over fill, which stays as the solid fallback.
shape.fills: Fill stack, bottom first (two or more layers). When set, fill/fillGradient mirror the top visible layer.
shape.strokeStyle: Stroke pattern; dash-march loops need dashed or dotted.
shape.strokeDash: Legacy dash length, px; strokeStyle wins.
shape.strokeDashes: [dash, gap] in px; wins over strokeStyle.
shape.strokeAlign: Where the stroke sits on the outline. Absent = inside on rect, ellipse, triangle; centred on arrow and path.
shape.strokeGradient: Gradient along the stroke; wins over stroke (a line's fill).
shape.strokes: Stroke stack, bottom first (two or more layers). When set, stroke/strokeWidth/strokeAlign/strokeDashes mirror the top visible layer.
shape.radii: Per-corner radius [top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left], rect only; wins over radius.
shape.heads: Arrow only: 2 puts a head at both ends.
shape.lineStart: Tip at a line's or open path's start.
shape.lineEnd: Tip at a line's or open path's end.
shape.d: Path only: SVG path data in pathBox coordinates.
shape.pathBox: Path only: [x, y, w, h] viewBox the path was drawn in, stretched into the element box.
shape.from: Connector start: follows an element's border (line or path only).
shape.to: Connector end: follows an element's border (line or path only).
shape.layout: Makes a rect a frame that lays out the elements whose parentId names it.
shape.bool: A vector boolean: d/pathBox hold the computed outline; the operands ride along for re-editing.

shapeBool.shapes: The operand shapes, bottom first, in slide coordinates as they were when combined.

image.fit: How the picture fills the box.
image.crop: Pan and zoom inside the frame. Absent = fit alone.

svg.asset: Key into assets holding raw SVG markup (preferred: dedupes).
svg.markup: Raw inline SVG markup, used when asset is unset.
svg.css: CSS injected inside the svg, scoped to it (hover states, animations).

chart.option: ECharts-shaped option as plain JSON, drawn by charts-lite. Bar and line data are plain numbers; template formatters only.
chart.preset: The panel's re-seed key: bar, line, pie or scatter.
chart.source: Live binding: labels and series values track a table element.

chartSource.tableId: The table element's id on the same slide.

table.columns: Column weights, normalised at render; one entry per column.
table.header: Row 0 is a styled header row.
table.style: The table-wide look; cells carry only overrides.

media.src: data: URI (embedded), URL or relative path (referenced), or `asset:<key>`.
media.poster: Video only: still shown before playback.
media.fit: Video only: how the frame fills the box.
media.autoplay: Starts on arrival, in the show only; video needs muted.
media.muted: No sound; required for video autoplay.

embed.app: The app that made it (bento/dash, bento/type …), or web for a page.
embed.view: The static render that always paints: raw `<svg>` markup or `asset:<key>`. Required in practice.
embed.url: app web only: the http(s) page a live frame loads.
embed.live: Opt in to a sandboxed live frame over the view while online.

component.id: The component; every element of the main and of each copy carries it.
component.key: Pairs a copy's element with its counterpart in the main.
component.over: A copy's own overrides: the keys it does not take from the main.
component.off: A copy's [dx, dy] offset from its main, written by the app.
component.sig: Hash of the main state a copy last followed, written by the app. Omit it: without it a copy's differences count as overrides.

fx.enter: Entrance animation when the slide shows. Skipped for an element that morphs in from the previous slide.
fx.enterDur: Entrance duration in seconds. Absent = 0.75 for slide-*, 0.55 for fade-*.
fx.order: Stagger order in the entrance sequence; equal values enter together.
fx.step: Click build: 1 or more hides the element until the n-th → reveals it (with its enter, or a fade). Absent/0 = shown with the slide.
fx.countUp: Animate the numbers in the text from 0.
fx.ambient: Continuous ambient motion: kenburns, for full-bleed photos.
fx.typeWriter: Code only: the text types in a character at a time when it appears.
fx.loop: A continuous loop: dash-march or motion-path.

fxKen.dir: drift (default) loops a slow zoom; out and in play once per arrival.
fxKen.scale: The far end of the zoom, e.g. 1.08.

fxLoop.type: dash-march marches a dashed stroke; motion-path moves the element along path.
fxLoop.distance: dash-march: px the dashes travel per lap.
fxLoop.path: motion-path: SVG path data relative to the element's resting position (the first anchor is where it sits).
fxLoop.delay: motion-path: seconds before the first lap.
fxLoop.ease: motion-path: easing over each lap. Default none (constant tempo).
fxLoop.speeds: motion-path: one speed multiplier per anchor (1 normal, below 1 dwells, above 1 rushes).

gradient.kind: radial: stops run from (cx, cy) out to r. Absent = linear.
gradient.cx: Radial centre x as a fraction of the box. Default 0.5.
gradient.cy: Radial centre y as a fraction of the box. Default 0.5.
gradient.r: Radial radius as a fraction of the box. Default 0.5.

paintLayer.color: The layer's colour; with a gradient, its solid fallback.
paintLayer.blend: How the layer mixes with what lies beneath it. Absent = normal.

strokeLayer.color: The layer's colour; with a gradient, its solid fallback.
strokeLayer.align: Where the stroke sits on the outline.
strokeLayer.blend: How the layer mixes with what lies beneath it. Absent = normal.

connectorEnd.el: Id of the element this end follows, on the same slide.
connectorEnd.side: Which border to attach to; auto picks the nearest.

frameLayout.dir: Main axis: row, col, or a grid of equal cells.
frameLayout.pad: Padding inside the frame [top, right, bottom, left], px.
frameLayout.align: Cross-axis alignment; stretch fills it. Default start.
frameLayout.cols: Grid only: number of columns. Default 2.
frameLayout.clip: Children are clipped to the frame.
frameLayout.hug: The frame sizes itself to its children.
frameLayout.wrap: Row/col only: a child that would pass the edge starts a new line.

sizing.w: fill takes the frame's free width; fixed (or absent) keeps w.
sizing.h: fill takes the frame's free height; fixed (or absent) keeps h.
sizing.minW: In a wrapping frame, the least width a fill child counts as when lines break.
sizing.minH: In a wrapping frame, the least height a fill child counts as when lines break.

imageCrop.x: Which edge of the enlarged picture the frame aligns to horizontally: 0 left, 0.5 centre, 1 right.
imageCrop.y: Vertical alignment the same way: 0 top, 1 bottom.

tableStyle.zebra: Stripe colour for alternate body rows. Absent = no stripes.

tableRow.cells: The row's cells, one per column.

tableCell.html: Cell content: the same sanitized subset as text html.
